newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans seek free mkt wheat, barley, rye exports.
newsitem.headline: Germans seek free mkt wheat, barley, rye exports.

text.p: German grain traders placed bids for the export of 27,500 tonnes of free market soft wheat with the rebate in a 14.49-24.90 Ecus per tonne range, intervention board BLE said on Thursday.

BLE also received bids for the export of 30,250 tonnes of free market barley, with the restitution sought in a 32.43-41.45 Ecus/tonne range, and 21,000 of free market rye, where the subsidy requested was 31.07-34.85 Ecus/tonne.
